description: This file defines the 'nl80211_socket' class, which extends a generic netlink socket class to specifically handle NL80211 wireless hardware configuration communication over netlink. It includes method declarations for connecting to the netlink socket and sending/receiving messages related to wireless configuration.

classes.name: nl80211_socket
classes.description: Extension of the nl_genl_socket class for NL80211-specific netlink communication, providing methods to connect and send/receive messages with Wi-Fi hardware configuration support.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes the netlink socket connection, retrieves the family id for nl80211, and prepares the socket for communication.

methods.name: send_receive_msg
methods.description: Performs a netlink request/response exchange with specified command and callback functions for message creation and handling.
